Transitly je neovisna informativna aplik: Transitly is an independent information app that displays selected public transport data. The ZET section shows available buses, trams, routes, directions, stops, positions reported by the source feed and departures. The HŽPP section lets you search for train connections by departure and arrival station, date and time, and displays itineraries, transfers, times and delays available in HŽPP's response. Transitly is independent of ZET and HŽPP and does not act on their behalf or serve as their official channel.
Transitly može privremeno ograničiti pri: Transitly may temporarily restrict access for maintenance, security or troubleshooting. You can stop using your account and request deletion at any time.
Transitly ne upravlja vozilima ni željez: Transitly does not operate vehicles or railway infrastructure, organise transport, or sell, issue, reserve or validate tickets. Viewing an itinerary does not create a contract of carriage.
Transitly vodi Din Mulajusufović: Transitly is run by Din Mulajusufović
Transitlyjeva aplikacija koristi nužne k: Transitly uses essential cookies to sign you in and local storage to save your preferences. Transitly includes no advertising or analytics tools. External services may use their own technologies.
U HŽPP prikazu odabirete polaznu i odred: In the HŽPP section, you choose a departure and arrival station, travel date and earliest departure time. Transitly searches HŽPP's publicly available web system and displays the itineraries it returns for your search. A connection may involve one or more trains and a transfer. Results show train numbers and transfer legs when this information is available.
U web-verziji se Google Identity Service: The web app loads Google Identity Services, Cloudflare Turnstile and OpenStreetMap when you use Google sign-in, a security check or the map. These providers may process technical data such as your IP address and browser information under their own privacy policies.
